message:
Fix deploy email: force IPv4 SMTP to fix ENETUNREACH on Render free tier

- Render free instances have no IPv6; smtp.gmail.com was resolving to
  IPv6 (2607:f8b0:...) and failing with ENETUNREACH
- Switch from service:'gmail' to explicit host/port/family:4 to force IPv4

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
